title: Art. 2.13.3 — American Convention on Human Rights, Part I, Chapter II, Article 13, Paragraph 3
content: The right of expression may not be restricted by indirect methods or means, such as the abuse of government or private controls over newsprint, radio broadcasting frequencies, or equipment used in the dissemination of information, or by any other means tending to impede the communication and circulation of ideas and opinions.
